chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Chick Webb features bass sax and "By-Heck"
summary: Coleman Hawkins also played bass sax; Chick Webb got McRae a Henderson arrangement and let him trade breaks on "By-Heck".

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Coleman had a -- Chick finally got this arrangement from Fletcher for me. It was a thing -- I forget the name of it. I was all for bass saxophone.
And then, (inaudible) that's the thing, Chick used to feature me on bass saxophone. And then he used to feature me on "By-Heck."
You know, with the breaks in it? Instead of him making the drum break, he let me make the breaks. I make some of the breaks and he makes some of the breaks. And they came out real good.
